concepts.name: Aligned Evidence
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: exploratory logo concept presentation, not final production branding.
Context: RVI + PKTAP Correlator is a native macOS investigation app that compares iPhone network packet observations, Mac process-aware packets, and logs on a normalized timeline, with evidence and uncertainty. It explores possible relationships without claiming causation.
Style: original premium minimalist geometric identity, crisp vector-like edges, precisely balanced negative space, thick simple forms readable as a small Dock icon. Current palette is deep ink navy #111823, soft white #F0F5FC, turquoise #59E0DC.
Composition: one landscape 3:2 concept card on a clean warm off-white background. Upper 75 percent: a single large macOS squircle app-icon tile, centered, navy with an extremely subtle depth gradient and restrained rim. Lower strip: the concept name in clean dark sans-serif and two small identical silhouette proofs, one in dark ink on a light swatch and one in white on a navy swatch. The proofs must use the exact same geometry as the large main symbol. Plenty of whitespace, clean straight-on view, no perspective.
Constraints: no shields, padlocks, Apple logos, Wireshark logos, stock network globe, circuit-board clutter, arrows, checkmarks, score numbers, drop shadows around lettering, watermarks, screenshots, or marketing claims. The symbol is for relationships between evidence, not a guarantee of security or proof of attribution. Do not place app-name text inside the icon. Only the specified concept name as text.
Text (verbatim): "01  Aligned Evidence".
Primary logo: an evolution of the current three-track icon. Three independent, thick horizontal white signal paths, with gently rounded transitions: upper path curves down to a shared horizontal alignment, center path straight, lower path curves up. Three turquoise hollow circular observation nodes sit on a slim turquoise vertical reference spine near the right third. The paths stay visibly separate and continue past their own nodes; they never merge. Make the mark bolder, quieter, and optically balanced, with clear empty centers in the nodes. The design reads as three evidence streams measured against one reference timeline. Carefully refine spacing and consistent stroke geometry for small-scale legibility.

Text (verbatim): "02  Correlation Lens".
Primary logo: a distinctive bold circular lens / open C aperture, built from two substantial opposing white semicircular arcs with deliberate gaps at top and bottom, not a magnifying glass handle. Inside the aperture, three short horizontal turquoise bars at different heights, each ending with a small round observation point; bars are separate and aligned to one invisible reference column. The arcs frame the evidence without enclosing or joining it. Make the white aperture silhouette dominant and the three teal measurements legible, uncluttered and contained. Use at most five principal components. No crosshair, target bullseye, camera shutter blades, eye illustration, or concentric-ring radar. The identity should convey examining and comparing evidence precisely.

Text (verbatim): "04  Evidence Layers".
Primary logo: three separate rounded geometric evidence bands stacked vertically, each a broad open parallelogram or gently folded card outline, with restrained shallow isometric geometry. Do not make a realistic paper stack. Use white for upper and lower bands and turquoise for the middle band. The three bands are spaced apart and remain individually readable. One simple turquoise vertical alignment notch passes beside the right-hand edges, with a small hollow round node on each layer. Reduce this into a compact distinctive glyph with no more than three layer outlines and one alignment feature, clear broad forms, balanced negative space and no tiny details. It conveys preserving distinct evidence sources while aligning them for review. No database cylinder, server rack, cube cluster, or illustration texture.
